events.title: Ruby on Rails open sourced
events.summary: David Heinemeier Hansson released Rails 0.5.0 — MVC infrastructure extracted from Basecamp.
events.about: Ruby on Rails is a web framework for database-backed sites — models, views, controllers out of the box. Used to ship CRUD apps fast: project tools (Basecamp), early Twitter/GitHub/Shopify, and countless startup MVPs. Convention over configuration means less boilerplate than hand-rolled PHP or Java servlets.

narrative.whyChosen: Rails popularized convention-over-configuration and made Ruby a global language for web startups.
narrative.whyImportant: Active Record and Action Pack became the template for modern full-stack web frameworks.
narrative.problemSolved: Building database-backed web apps required repetitive wiring; Rails packaged opinionated defaults.
